description: Render a background as SVG or PNG. Deterministic: the same structure, options and seed always give the same image, so store the returned seed. Returns the image inline (PNG previews are visible to you); pass saveTo to also write the file to disk. Call describe_background first to learn which shape options the structure honours.

format.description: png (default) returns a viewable image; svg returns the vector source.

height.description: Frame height in px. Defaults to the native size.

palette.description: Colour choices: explicit hex colours, a built-in palette id, or a primary colour to derive from.

backgroundColor.description: Hex colour of the canvas behind the shapes.

colors.description: Explicit hex colours to draw from (best for brand matching). Overrides palette/scheme.

gradientColor.description: Gradient fills instead of flat colour.

opaqueColors.description: true = no transparency in the shape fills.

palette.description: Id of a built-in palette from list_palettes, e.g. "underTheSea".

primaryColor.description: Main hex colour when not passing colors/palette.

secondaryColor.description: Second hex colour for two-tone structures.

pngWidth.description: Raster width for PNG output/preview. Defaults to the render width, capped for inline previews.

saveTo.description: Local file path to write the result to (extension decides svg/png if format is omitted).

seed.description: Any string. Omit for a fresh random seed (returned in the result).

shape.description: Structure-specific options; call describe_background for the exact keys, ranges and what they do.

width.description: Frame width in px. Defaults to the structure's native size (see describe_background).

name: generate_background

bytes.description: Local only: bytes written to disk.

hint.description: Hosted, no API key: how to get permanent URLs.

request.description: Resolved request incl. seed; replay it to reproduce or tweak.

savedTo.description: Local only: absolute path the file was written to.

seed.description: Seed used; reuse it to reproduce the exact image.

svgBytes.description: Size of the SVG source in bytes.

svgUrl.description: Hosted only: permanent URL of the SVG source.

url.description: Hosted only: permanent, cacheable image URL in the requested format.

warnings.description: Options that were ignored or clamped, and why.

title: Generate a background
